module: Flowgraph node "Get Photomode" (category provider, author BeamNG, tags photomode/photo/camera/screenshot/capture). Outputs a bool "value": true if photo mode is open, read from the global variable photoModeOpen.
notes: Depends on a global variable (photoModeOpen); it is nil if photo mode has never been initialized.

work.desc: Every frame, copies photoModeOpen to the value output.
